declarations.docstring: Equality of two natural-number parameters induces a Lie-module equivalence between the corresponding finite complex function spaces.
An auxiliary multiset of natural numbers associated with a natural-number-valued function on a finite type.
Equal value multisets for functions on finite types yield an equivalence of the index types that matches the function values.
Endomorphisms intertwined by a linear equivalence have kernels of equal dimension.
A linear equivalence that intertwines two endomorphisms also intertwines every natural power of them.
The kernel of the displayed endomorphism power on complex-valued functions on `Fin d` has dimension `min k d`.
Equivalent Lie modules have equal dimensions of the kernels of every power of their auxiliary endomorphisms.
For a finite dependent product, the kernel dimension of a power of the auxiliary endomorphism is the sum of the component kernel dimensions.
For the displayed dependent complex function space, the kernel dimension is the sum of `min k (n i + 1)` over the index type.
The displayed function of the auxiliary multiset equals the sum of `min k (n i + 1)` over the finite index type.
A pointwise family of Lie-module equivalences induces an equivalence between the corresponding dependent function modules.
An auxiliary complex-linear endomorphism of the displayed Lie module.
A Lie-module equivalence intertwines the auxiliary endomorphisms of its source and target.
On the finite complex function space, the auxiliary endomorphism is evaluation of the displayed representation at the displayed element.
The auxiliary endomorphism on a dependent function module is the pointwise family of component endomorphisms.
An equivalence of index types induces a Lie-module equivalence that reindexes a dependent function module.
Two finite-dimensional modules for the displayed Lie algebra are equivalent when all powers of their auxiliary endomorphisms have kernels of equal dimension.
Zero does not belong to the auxiliary multiset associated with the displayed natural-number-valued function.
